components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The clay-filled action used for the primary portal or form action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 46px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 15px; border: 1px solid #7d3626; border-radius: 7px; background: #a8452c; color: #fffaf1; font: 800 13px/1.4 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .18s ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #873923; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8b492b; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: #71331f; }

components.name: Service Shortcut Card
components.description: A generously sized home shortcut for Berita, Ronda, Bank Sampah, or Kas.
components.css: .ds-service-card { min-height: 104px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 15px; border: 1px solid #cbb99e; border-radius: 8px; background: #fffaf1; color: #38271f; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .18s ease-out, border-color .18s ease-out; } .ds-service-card:hover { border-color: #a8452c; background: #f4e8d5; } .ds-service-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8b492b; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-service-card__title { font: 800 14px/1.4 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-service-card__detail { color: #66594d; font: 400 12px/1.5 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Roster Input
components.description: A labeled form field for resident or administrator information.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-field">Nama pengurus</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-field" placeholder="Nama lengkap" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 7px; color: #44372d; font: 800 14px/1.4 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid #8f7d67; border-radius: 5px; background: #fffdf8; color: #38271f; font: 400 15px/1.5 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #625447; opacity: 1; } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: #8f3c27; outline: 3px solid #d7aa81; outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
This system treats the homepage like a neighborhood guard post handover board: residents should quickly recognize the RW, read the current notice and ronda details, then move into news or services. Warm roster-paper cream, dark brown ink, terracotta, and leaf green give practical information a familiar local character.

The interface is mobile-first and supports residents across age groups. Clear sans-serif interface text, prominent serif headings, strong dividers, readable status labels, and generous touch targets carry the visual hierarchy. Surfaces remain simple and functional, without decorative texture.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces with dark, high-contrast text.
Terracotta for primary actions; green for civic and positive status.
Strong rules and compact labels organize information.
Large, legible type and controls sized for touch.

rules.name: The Status-in-Words Rule
rules.body: Pair color-coded statuses with readable text and, where present, an icon.

dos: Do use Bahasa Indonesia and keep essential neighborhood information quick to find on a phone.
Do pair status color with a text label and supporting icon where available.
Do use the paper, ink, clay, and leaf palette and the established serif/sans pairing.
Do preserve large controls, visible keyboard focus, and responsive single-column reading.
Do keep card depth flat and use borders and tonal paper shifts to group information.
donts: Don't introduce decorative paper textures; the selected direction uses plain paper-toned surfaces.
Don't rely on color alone to explain a status.
Don't replace the clear information hierarchy with an undifferentiated run of cards.
Don't reduce mobile tap targets below the established 44px minimum for common controls.
